incident.description: The shell timeout detached the earliest resumable runner instead of terminating its Python child. A later resume briefly wrote an alternate completion before the earliest process completed and became the canonical final writer.
incident.discarded_output_policy: The later-started duplicate completion is discarded. The earliest-started process output is retained without rerunning or selecting results by quality.
incident.affected_positions: 31-40 may have been computed by both processes; the retained file contains the earliest-started process results.
